name: cross-review
description: Two reviewers from different vendors review the same code, design or document blind, cross-examine each other's findings, and a fresh auditor settles each one: execution-gated, identity-blinded, refutation-asymmetric.

interface.shortDescription: Review code and documents with two models from different vendors, then cross-examine the findings
interface.longDescription: cross-review runs two reviewers on the same target, exchanges their findings with identities hidden, and settles each finding with a fresh auditor. It produces findings.json, a scorecard and a manifest. A review run from a Codex host is a trial route in 1.1.0 (see references/hosts/codex.md); Claude Code is the primary host.
